objective: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

description: These bottles hold a vile, green venom.
Considering the number of bottles in this village, the Witherbarks must deem it very important.  Perhaps an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill would like a sample.
progress: Hello, gentle <class>. The day has been long and not a single experiment successful...I hope you bring good news to me.
completion: Ah, and what is this? It appears to be venom... from some arachnoid creature I deem. And where did you get it?
